# Production-primary implementation plan

Goal: implement the owner-approved production-primary acceptance and qualify one coherent production source on original PR101.

Architecture: extend the existing native acceptance module and publication consumer. Preserve the original gate functions/results, pinned references, runner and scenario generator. No research framework or new dependency.

Specification: contract.json in this directory. Original no-waiver contract remains immutable and separately NOT_MET.

- [ ] Freeze exact policy choices and document lost protections before new comparison runs; preserve to original PR branch.
- [ ] Recover exact C and state-sparse source; verify data fingerprint and source receipts. Reuse existing compatible diagnostic rows and fill missing prefixes. Rank surviving candidates by the frozen rule.
- [ ] Add fail-closed native acceptance tests: insufficient/mismatched/duplicate scenarios, nonfinite or nonpositive wealth, production failure, separate family median/P10/min failure, and unchanged risk/promotion failures. Implement the new evaluation in native_joint.py without changing legacy gates.
- [ ] Audit selected production source against current branch. Port only its intended production changes and relevant tests, retaining later correctness and CI fixes. Apply causal holding/risk changes only if comparison exposes a binding failure with a distinct supported mechanism.
- [ ] Run affected account/execution/risk tests and missing mandatory fixed paths, then the preregistered random screen. Preserve exact source, configuration, data, runner, original outcomes and new-contract evaluation.
- [ ] Only after no known necessary failure, bind the stable final source and run the complete formal958, registered external diagnostics and qualification. Integrate recomputed acceptance at every native publication consumer; preserve original-contract report and immutable historical artifacts. Verify economic goldens independently before updating intended behavior expectations.
- [ ] Review relevant complete diff, satisfy actual repository checks, save and verify remote identity. Normally merge the same final passing candidate into main and verify. A checkpoint is not completion; failures require causal diagnosis and a supported next action.
